description:
Rewrite Interactive's render pipeline to use the new message components instead of plain text.

Currently: transcript is [{:user, text} | {:assistant, text, status}], rendered as plain strings.
Target: transcript entries become component structs (AssistantMessage, UserMessage, ToolExecution), each rendering via their own render/2.

Changes to Interactive:
- Replace transcript list with message component list
- Handle agent events to create/update proper components:
  - MessageUpdate/MessageEnd → AssistantMessage
  - ToolStart/ToolResult → ToolExecution
  - UserInput → UserMessage
- Auto-scroll to bottom on new content
- Compose: header + messages + input + footer (reserve lines for each)

This is the integration ticket that makes T2 components visible.
Depends on: AssistantMessage, UserMessage, ToolExecution, footer wiring
title: Message rendering pipeline: replace transcript text with components
